shop.title: Open your shop and publish its page
shop.lead: What your clients see, and how they book. Nothing is public until you publish it.

p: From your account, choose Open a shop. You give its name, its trade and its address; the trade sets the words your screens and your clients read.

In Boutique, under Your page, you write the shop name, one line in French and in English, who you are, and the phone and e-mail shown to visitors. You choose which sections the page has and in which order.
Add your services with their duration and price, the hours when each person works and, if you travel, the areas you serve. Prices are shown before taxes.
Turn on Publish the page. Clients then find it at its address and can book. You can change the address: the old one still leads to your page.

In Boutique, Languages, you choose the languages of your page. The other texts are translated automatically from the one you write in, and you can edit each one. A text marked « translated automatically » has not been read by you yet.
In Boutique, Team, you invite the people who work in the shop. Each has their own hours, and a client can choose a person or leave it to anyone who is free.

bookings.title: Take a booking and confirm it
bookings.lead: The client's four steps, and what you see.

p: Everything is in the address, so a booking can be shared or resumed.
items: Choose a service on your page.
Choose a person, or anyone free, and an area if you travel.
Pick a time: only times that are really free are shown.
Confirm. The sign-in is at this last step, and the choices are kept.

p: The client sees when, with whom, where and the price, can add it to a calendar and finds it in their bookings.
Your page tells clients how long before the visit they can cancel for free (« Free until N h before the visit »). Within that window they cancel themselves; after it, they are asked to call the shop.
The bookings are on Today, day by day.

invoices.title: Issue and correct an invoice
invoices.lead: A bilingual invoice with the GST and QST exact to the cent.

p: In Invoices, choose New invoice. Pick the client, add a line for a service or write your own with its price and quantity, and check the total. The invoice is dated today and gets its number when you issue it; the due date follows your payment terms.
The GST (5 %) and the QST (9.975 %) are worked out once per invoice, on the taxable subtotal, and rounded to the cent.
An issued invoice never changes. Choose Correct: Akinaza issues the credit note of the invoice and the new invoice together, and links them. The client, the language and the terms stay the same.

Send the invoice by e-mail. The client opens it from a private link, where they can print it or save it as a PDF. In Boutique, Invoice e-mails, you set the message and how long the link stays open; a link that is no longer valid leads to a page not found.

books.title: Your books: the GST and QST of a period
books.lead: Akinaza prepares the figures. You check them and you file.

p: Your books show the lines of the GST/QST return for a period: sales (line 101), GST collected (103), input tax credits (106) and the net GST (109), then QST collected (203), input tax refunds (206) and the net QST (209). The result says whether you have something to remit, a refund to claim or nothing.
Every figure is worked out from your invoices, with credit notes taken off, and your expenses. Next to a figure you see how many documents are behind it, and you can open them.
Akinaza never files a return and never sends anything to Revenu Québec or the Canada Revenue Agency. Check each figure, then file the return yourself. These figures are not tax or accounting advice.

data.title: Your data
data.lead: What Akinaza keeps about you, and your right to it.

p: In your account, Your data, Export gives you everything held about the account as one file.
Delete my account erases your client files first. A shop's books are kept, because the tax law requires it (six years).

A client's consent is recorded for each purpose and can be withdrawn. Erasing a client blanks their personal fields and keeps the invoices that the law requires. Records are kept in a database in Canada, encrypted at rest, and visible to your shop only.
The privacy notice says who is in charge of the protection of personal information and how to exercise your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Akinaza is in development: only the accounts our team creates can sign in. A shop's data — its clients, appointments, invoices and tax ledger — is kept in Akinaza's database in Canada, encrypted at rest, visible to that shop only. Client consent is recorded per purpose and can be withdrawn; a client's personal information can be erased, while the invoices tax law requires are kept. The tax figures Akinaza prepares are computed from the period's ledger inside Akinaza; nothing is produced for, filed with or transmitted to any government. Nothing is sold. To ask a question or have your data removed, use the contact form.

processors.title: Who processes information for us
processors.lead: Akinaza uses service providers under written contracts, only to run the service. Where a provider stores data is stated here only once we have confirmed it.

items.p: The application and its database run with a cloud hosting provider.
The photos and files you add (a shop's photos, the files of a client's request) are stored with a media storage and delivery provider. In development, that store is in New York, United States.
Mails such as walk reports and invoices go through an e-mail delivery provider, only when sending is turned on.
A subscription is paid on the hosted page of a payment processor; Akinaza never sees or keeps a card number.
If translating a shop page is turned on, the page's own texts are sent to Krizaka's engine, Orazaka. Nothing about a client is sent.

governance.title: How we handle personal information
items: Why we collect it: to run a shop's bookings, invoices and tax figures, and the account of the person who signs in. Nothing else.
Who can see it: the shop that holds it, and the few people who run the service. A shop never sees another shop's data.
How long we keep it: invoices and the tax ledger for six years, as tax law requires; the rest until it is erased at your request.
Your rights: to see it, correct it, take a copy in a common format, withdraw a consent or have it erased. Write to the person in charge above; we answer within 30 days.
If something goes wrong: we follow a written procedure for confidentiality incidents, and we tell the Commission d'accès à l'information and the persons concerned when the law asks us to.

terms.status: A good-faith version written from the law, waiting for a lawyer's review before Akinaza opens to the public. If in doubt, the French version prevails.

sections.h: 1. Who we are, who these terms are for
sections.p: Akinaza is a product of Technologies Krizaka Inc. (Montréal, Québec), the publisher. These terms govern the subscription to Akinaza by service businesses in Québec: salons, workshops, coaches, cleaning businesses, pet services, consultants. Restaurants, cafés, bars and bakeries are excluded, because the law requires them to use a certified sales recording module, which Akinaza's point of sale is not. This is a contract of adhesion (art. 1379 of the Civil Code of Québec, C.C.Q.): we show it to you before any payment, and an illegible, incomprehensible or abusive clause has no effect against you (art. 1435 to 1437 C.C.Q.).

Akinaza gives you a shop page and bookings, bilingual invoices with GST and QST exact to the cent, an accounting ledger that never erases, and a tax report prepared from that ledger. The service is in development: a feature marked « soon » is not sold and is not part of your subscription. A booking is a contract between your client and you; Akinaza is not a party to it, it provides the tool.

Akinaza prepares, you file. It never produces, signs or transmits a return to Revenu Québec or the Canada Revenue Agency: it is for you to check the prepared figures and to file them, under the Act respecting the Québec sales tax (CQLR, c. T-0.1) and the Excise Tax Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. E-15). The prepared figures are neither tax advice nor accounting advice. Akinaza is not a cash register: it does not replace the sales recording module that a restaurant or a bar must use.

sections.h: 4. The subscription, the price and the renewal
sections.p: The subscription is monthly and renews by itself at the end of each period until you cancel. The price is the one in the catalogue published on the pricing page when you subscribe, plus the applicable taxes; it is kept with your subscription, and a price change does not apply to a subscription already sold unless you are told in writing at least 30 days ahead and can cancel before it takes effect. No fee can be charged unless the contract states it (art. 12 of the Consumer Protection Act, CPA). A feature marked « soon » is not billed.

The subscription is paid on the hosted payment page of our payment processor: Akinaza never sees or keeps your card number. The payments of your own clients, when they are offered, go through your own account with your own processor: the money goes straight from the client to you. Akinaza never holds funds, does not keep anything for you or for your client, does not act as a trustee and keeps nothing back. The processor's fees are those of your contract with it; Akinaza's fees on these payments are shown on the pricing page (no percentage on cards, a capped amount for pre-authorised debit).

You can cancel at any time, even while the service is under way (art. 2125 C.C.Q.), from the payment page opened from your subscription: the cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period and nothing is charged after it. You pay for the service rendered until then (art. 2129 C.C.Q.); the current period is not refunded, except for a billing error, a double charge or where the law requires it. On our side, we can cancel only for a serious reason (non-payment, unlawful use, a threat to the security of the service) and never at an inopportune moment (art. 2126 C.C.Q.); we tell you in writing. You can export your data before or after cancelling.

The information about your clients that you enter stays yours: you are responsible for it and Akinaza processes it on your behalf, in a database in Canada, encrypted at rest, visible to your shop only; the photos and files you add are stored with a media provider, named in the privacy notice. Consent is asked per purpose, never pre-ticked, and can be withdrawn; erasure blanks the personal fields and keeps the invoices tax law requires us to keep (six years). All of this falls under the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (CQLR, c. P-39.1), as amended by the Act to modernize legislative provisions as regards the protection of personal information (S.Q. 2021, c. 25). The details, the person in charge of the protection of personal information and how to exercise your rights are in the privacy notice.

We answer for our faults. We are not liable for a tax return you file, nor for the penalties, interest or delays that follow, nor for disputes between you and your clients, nor for an interruption of the service that is not our fault. Except for intentional or gross fault, our liability to you is limited to the amounts you paid for the subscription in the 12 months before the event, and we are not liable for indirect damage (lost profit, lost opportunity). None of these limits applies to intentional or gross fault, nor to bodily or moral injury (art. 1474 C.C.Q.), nor to what a consumer cannot waive (art. 10 CPA).

sections.h: 9. If you act as a consumer
sections.p: Akinaza is for businesses. If you contract as an individual, for a use that is not your business, the Consumer Protection Act (CQLR, c. P-40.1) applies and nothing in these terms limits your rights: notably the rules for a contract made at a distance (art. 54.1 and following CPA, including the information before the contract, the copy of the contract and the cancellation provided by art. 54.8), the ban on an arbitration clause or one that takes away a class action (art. 11.1 CPA) and the ban on limiting our liability for our own acts (art. 10 CPA). You can also turn to the Office de la protection du consommateur.

We may change these terms. We tell you in writing at least 30 days before a change that affects you takes effect, and you can cancel before then. The version and its date are shown at the top of this page; the version you accepted is kept with your subscription.
These terms are written in French, the reference version, as the Charter of the French Language requires (art. 55). The English version is a courtesy translation; if they differ, the French prevails.

These terms are governed by the laws of Québec and the federal laws of Canada that apply there. The courts of Québec have jurisdiction. A consumer can always sue in the district where they live, and cannot waive that in advance (art. 3149 C.C.Q.; art. 33 of the Code of Civil Procedure).

sections.h: 13. Intellectual property and your right to use the service
sections.p: Akinaza, its software, its document templates, the design of the shop pages, its names, its birds and its marks belong to Technologies Krizaka Inc. or its licensors; these terms assign you none of those rights (Copyright Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. C-42). For the length of your subscription only, you receive a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable right to use the hosted service for the needs of your business; that right ends with the subscription. Your shop's content and your clients' information stay yours (section 7): you only authorise us to host and process them to provide the service. Akinaza's source code is published under its own licence, stated in its repository: these terms govern the hosted service, that licence governs the code, and nothing here removes what the licence allows you.

Without a written agreement with Krizaka, you may not: resell, rent, sublicense or offer the hosted service to third parties, or present it under another brand (white label); use it to build or improve a competing service; extract its content or data by automated means beyond the exports the service offers; circumvent your plan's limits, the billing or the security measures; or decompile or disassemble the parts of the hosted service that are not published, except to the extent the law allows despite this clause. A breach may lead to suspended access, after written notice where the situation allows.

The names and logos of Akinaza and Krizaka, and their birds, are marks of Technologies Krizaka Inc. (Trademarks Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. T-13). These terms, like the code licence, grant no right to those marks; their use is governed by the policy published at https://github.com/krizaka/.github/blob/main/TRADEMARKS.md.
Through Krizaka's contact form (topic Akinaza), or at contact@krizaka.com for your personal information. We answer within 30 days.

invoiced.name: Invoiced
invoiced.meaning: What you billed in the period, before taxes. A credit note takes away what it cancels.
invoiced.formula: Total of your invoices before taxes, minus your credit notes.

collected.name: Collected
collected.meaning: The money you actually received in the period, whatever the invoice date.
collected.formula: Total of the payments received in the period. Beside it: that total over what you invoiced with taxes.

toCollect.name: To collect
toCollect.meaning: What your clients still owe you today, on all your invoices.
toCollect.formula: Invoices with taxes, minus the payments received. The overdue part is those past their due date.

gstCollected.name: GST collected
gstCollected.meaning: The GST (5 %) your invoices charged in the period.
gstCollected.formula: Sum of the GST of your invoices in the period, credit notes taken off.

qstCollected.name: QST collected
qstCollected.meaning: The QST (9.975 %) your invoices charged in the period.
qstCollected.formula: Sum of the QST of your invoices in the period, credit notes taken off.

gstToRemit.name: GST to remit
gstToRemit.meaning: What you would pay to the government for the GST, if the period ended today. Akinaza prepares it; you file it.
gstToRemit.formula: GST collected on your invoices, minus the GST you may claim back on your expenses.

qstToRemit.name: QST to remit
qstToRemit.meaning: What you would pay to Revenu Québec for the QST, if the period ended today. Akinaza prepares it; you file it.
qstToRemit.formula: QST collected on your invoices, minus the QST you may claim back on your expenses.

margin.name: Margin
margin.meaning: What is left of your revenue after your expenses, before taxes. It does not count your pay or costs you did not record.
margin.formula: Invoiced before taxes, minus your expenses before taxes at the share used for the business.

appointments.name: Appointments
appointments.meaning: The appointments that took place in the period.
appointments.formula: Number of appointments marked as done.

noShows.name: No-shows
noShows.meaning: The appointments where the client did not come, out of those that were due.
noShows.formula: No-shows over done appointments plus no-shows.

lexicon.title: Lexique
lexicon.intro: The words of your figures, in plain language.

tpsTvq.definition: Two sales taxes you charge your clients and pass on to the government: the GST (5 %, federal) and the QST (9.975 %, Québec). You collect them; you remit what you collected minus what you paid on your own business expenses.

htTtc.definition: Before taxes is the price without GST and QST; with taxes is what the client pays. Your revenue is counted before taxes, because the taxes are not yours.

margin.definition: What is left of your revenue after your expenses, before taxes. Here it only counts the expenses you recorded: your pay, your tax on income and costs not entered are not in it.

collectedVsInvoiced.definition: Invoiced is what you billed; collected is the money you really received. The gap is what clients still owe you.

declarationPeriod.definition: The stretch of time (a month, a quarter or a year, depending on how you file) covered by one GST/QST return. Akinaza prepares its figures; you review and file the return yourself.

noShow.definition: An appointment where the client did not come and did not cancel.

newTag.title: New tag
newTag.hint: A name and a colour marker. The tag belongs to the shop: the owner and the manager can add and rename it.
newTag.name: Name

views.label: Views
views.saveHint: The view keeps the tags, the dates and the search in force. Its address is the same on every device.
views.name: Name of the view

preview.title: Live preview
preview.label: Preview of your page
preview.unpublished: Publish your page to see it here.

wall.title: The wall
wall.lead: Photos, words on cards and your sign, pinned where you want them. Visitors see them on your page, in this order.
wall.empty: Nothing is pinned yet. Add a photo, a card or your sign.
wall.drawn: The page draws the first {drawn}; the others stay in the list underneath.
wall.stage: The wall as laid out. Select a piece, then use the keys.
wall.keys: Arrow keys move the piece (Shift for larger steps), [ and ] tilt it, Page Up and Page Down change its layer.
wall.textFr: Word on the card in French (140 characters)
wall.textEn: Word on the card in English (140 characters)
wall.signNote: The sign shows your shop's name.
wall.moved: Moved to {x} % across, {y} % down, tilted {rotation} degrees.

board.title: The bulletin board
board.lead: Up to three flyers are pinned on your page, the newest first. A flyer comes down on its last day.
board.endsOnHint: Leave empty to keep it up until you take it down.

reels.title: Your latest video
reels.lead: The newest video plays on your page in an old television. A link to TikTok, YouTube or Instagram shows a picture and a button: nothing is loaded from the platform until the visitor presses it.
reels.linkLabel: Link to a TikTok, a YouTube Short or an Instagram reel
reels.linkHint: Paste the address of the video.
reels.uploadHint: MP4 or WebM, vertical, {seconds} seconds and {megabytes} MB at most.
reels.socialLead: Plain links to your pages. Nothing from these platforms loads on your page; a visitor leaves only by following one.
reels.socialHint: Leave empty to remove a link.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.lead: Only verified reviews, from clients who had an appointment, count in your score. Reply in public, or hide a review from your page.
reviews.notShown: Your score is shown on your page from {min} verified reviews. You have {count}.

composer.title: Shop page
composer.addSectionHint: Choose what to add to your page.
composer.noSelection: Choose a section to change how it is drawn.
composer.publishNothing: Nothing has changed since the last publication.

composerPanel.accentNote: Only the colours tested for this style are offered.
composerPanel.versionsLead: The page now live, the draft, and the last versions. Restoring one publishes it again as a new version.
composerPanel.restoredKept: Version {n} is live again. Your draft is unchanged.
composerPanel.keepDraft: Keep my draft when I restore
composerPanel.discardAsk: Throw the draft away and go back to the live page?
composerPanel.discarded: Changes discarded. The composer shows your live page.
composerPanel.restored: Version {n} is live again. Your draft was reset to it.
composerPanel.noVersions: Nothing has been published yet: your page shows the starter of your trade.
composerPanel.readOnly: You can read the page; the owner and the manager change it.
composerPanel.openPreview: Open the preview in a new tab

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page does not exist, or is not yours.

explore.title: Explorer
explore.lead: Find a shop near you: on the map, or in the list. Only what each shop already shows on its own page.

search.label: Address or postal code
search.placeholder: An address or a postal code
search.centredOnYou: Nearest first from where you are
search.nearMeNote: Your position is used once, in this page, and never stored.
search.denied: Your position is not available. Search an address or a postal code instead.
search.unavailable: The address search is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
search.off: The address search is not set up yet. “Near me” and the filters still work.
search.none: No place found for “{query}”. Check the address or try the postal code.

map.label: Map of the shops
map.hint: The map loads when you open it.

empty.title: No shop matches
empty.text: Try fewer filters, or another address.

error.text: The shops could not be loaded.
